components.name: confidence
components.definition: generator interface pTM, supplied by the caller; tcren does not compute it

components.name: energy
components.definition: structural poly-alanine reference difference on the TCR:peptide interface, the contacted CDR residues truncated to alanine in 3D with the contact map rebuilt (export --quantity receptor-reference --reference-mode structural)

components.name: geometry
components.definition: height-field Pearson complementarity between the TCR underside and the pMHC face

components.name: topology
components.definition: (E - V + C) / E over CDR:peptide + peptide:MHC + CDR:MHC residue contacts, no internal edges

standardization: means and scales frozen on a held-out training pool of 729 models over 14 off-panel epitopes; no label was read to produce them, so this is a change of units and not a fit
sign_source: fixed a priori by what each component means; the training pool is used only to check them, and each component records the pool's verdict
combination: w*iptm+(1-w)*g_recognition_cyclo_frac; w=0.55 by default, 0.90 for explicitly absent templates. Missing active inputs are omitted with weights renormalized.
topology_standardization: Identity for the new topology descriptor: z_topology is its raw fraction, not a newly estimated reference moment.
weight_selection: Two benchmark-selected weights; no query-cohort fitting.
